evals.prompt: Our EdTech platform serves students in 15 countries. API latency from centralized US-East servers is 350ms for European users and 500ms for Asian users. Propose an edge computing strategy to reduce latency below 100ms globally.
evals.expected_output: Proposes edge deployment across multiple regions, identifies which endpoints can be served from edge, suggests caching and data replication strategy.
assertions: Proposes multi-region edge deployment with specific region recommendations
Identifies which API endpoints are suitable for edge serving vs centralized
Includes a caching or data replication strategy to handle state at the edge

evals.prompt: Evaluate Cloudflare Workers, Deno Deploy, and AWS Lambda@Edge for serving our quiz API at the edge. Our backend is FastAPI/Python.
evals.expected_output: Compares all three platforms on Python support, cold start times, pricing, and global coverage. Notes Python limitations on some platforms.
assertions: Evaluates all three platforms with specific comparisons on latency and cold starts
Identifies Python compatibility constraints on each platform
Recommends the best option with cost and performance justification

evals.prompt: Design a CDN caching strategy for our learning content API. Content types include: static course materials (rarely change), quiz questions (change weekly), and real-time leaderboards (change per second).
evals.expected_output: Proposes tiered caching with long TTLs for static content, short TTLs for quizzes, and no-cache or WebSocket for leaderboards, with cache invalidation strategy.
assertions: Assigns different cache TTLs based on content change frequency
Proposes cache invalidation or purge mechanisms for quiz content updates
Recommends real-time delivery (WebSocket or SSE) for leaderboard data instead of caching

evals.prompt: Our edge nodes in Southeast Asia are experiencing 15% failure rates during peak hours. Design a failover and graceful degradation strategy.
evals.expected_output: Proposes health-check-based failover to nearest healthy region, local caching for degraded mode, circuit breaker pattern, and user-facing degradation messaging.
assertions: Designs automatic failover to the nearest healthy edge region
Proposes local caching or stale-while-revalidate for graceful degradation
Includes a circuit breaker pattern to prevent cascading failures

evals.prompt: We want to move AI inference for personalized learning recommendations to the edge. The model is 500MB. Is this feasible, and what strategies would you recommend?
evals.expected_output: Analyzes model size constraints at the edge, proposes model compression, distillation, or split inference strategies. Evaluates WebAssembly for inference.
assertions: Identifies the 500MB model size as a challenge for edge deployment
Proposes model compression techniques such as quantization, pruning, or distillation
Evaluates WebAssembly or ONNX runtime as edge inference options
